description: Draft one approved section, then have an independent reviewer check it (WTF-P's draft-review playbook).

inputs.name: section
inputs.description: The section to draft, as the outline names it (for example background)

steps.input: Draft section {section} from its explicitly approved plan into its declared paper artifact (paper/sections/{section}.tex) and update only its declared summary. $task
Independently review section {section} as drafted against its plan, sources, decisions and venue constraints. Do not claim or make any change. The draft step reported: $draft
